observations: Multiple pressing irons of various colors and designs are displayed on a wooden surface.
The irons are arranged in rows, suggesting a retail or wholesale setting.
The background shows a metal door and a corrugated metal wall, typical of a shop or warehouse.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are legible on the irons in the photo.
The irons appear to be in good cosmetic condition, but internal mechanical and electrical health cannot be determined from a photo.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the irons from a distance; internal cleanliness and the condition of the soleplate cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The irons may be generic or third-party brands rather than well-known imported brands.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand logo and model number on the soleplate or the back of the iron.

risks.risk: The heating elements or steam mechanisms may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron heating up and producing steam.

risks.risk: The irons may be used for commercial purposes and have been heavily used.
risks.proof: A photo of the soleplate showing the manufacturer's logo and the model number.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the soleplate of the specific iron you are interested in.
Video of the iron plugged in and heating up.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
